title: Animated chart with one takeaway
summary: A single chart that makes one point: bars or columns grow from zero with values counting at their tips (or a line draws itself), every other mark recedes while the key mark keeps the accent, and a takeaway rises in over the source line.
needs: Three to six labelled values in one unit, and who published them (a source), stated in the brief
techniques: staggered bar growth from a zero baseline
gallery_share: Animated bar and line charts are among the most requested explainer and social data videos.
limits: One series, zero or positive values only: no negative values, stacked, grouped or dual-axis charts, and no bar-chart race.
The template takes three to six values; the recipe takes two to eight, and portrait frames with eight values need short copy.
Line charts label only the first, last and key points; the scale starts at zero unless the recipe's y_from_zero is turned off, which adds labelled gridlines.
Verbatim checks prove a value appears in the brief, not that it is paired with the right label; the data_accuracy gate is a person's job.
